svg.title: Cross-sector TK convergence and divergence by technology-enabled retention practice
svg.desc: A radial matrix of thirteen technology-enabled retention practices. Three concentric rings show identification in Construction, Manufacturing, and Health Services. External callouts list tacit-knowledge relationships that converge across sectors or diverge by appearing in only one sector.

g.text: Sector combinations appear in the radial matrix; callouts distinguish recurring and sector-specific TK relationships.
Worker Activity and State Capture through Wearable

text.tspan: TK convergence means the same TP–TK relationship appears in at least two sectors; TK divergence means it appears in only one sector.

g.text: “None identified” and uncolored sector cells refer only to the selected evidence and do not establish absence.
C = Construction · M = Manufacturing · H = Health Services
